name: SymSearch
description: SymSearch is a scalable symbolic benchmark for evaluating semantic reasoning in interactive object search tasks within 3D scene graphs. It measures the ability to understand and utilize relational semantics for efficient open-world object search in household environments.
reputation: A niche but credible recent benchmark from the embodied/3D reasoning literature, with limited but growing use in semantic object-search evaluation.
notes: Focuses on semantic reasoning over 3D scene graphs for interactive object search; supports open-vocabulary generalization and real-time deployment.
